violations.affected_code:
GestureDetector(
      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
      onTap: onOpenTerms,
      child: Container(...Text('Read the Terms of Service')...))
violations.explanation: GestureDetector does not expose a button or link role to assistive technologies. Screen readers will announce the text but not indicate that it is an actionable link/button. It should be wrapped in Semantics(link: true or button: true) or replaced with a TextButton/InkWell, which provide the proper semantics.

GestureDetector is not focusable and does not respond to keyboard activation (Enter/Space). Keyboard and switch-access users cannot reach or activate the terms link. Material buttons or InkWell, or a FocusableActionDetector, would provide focus and keyboard support.

violations.affected_code: Container(constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 48), alignment: Alignment.centerLeft, child: Text(...))
violations.explanation: There is no focus or highlight feedback, so even if focus were managed, users would have no visual indication of the focused interactive element.
